discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: The 2024 and 2025 prizes went to machine learning and macroscopic quantum tunneling in superconducting circuits. Foundational theoretical work in quantum physics is now well overdue for recognition. Geometric phases underpin topological matter, quantum computing and modern condensed-matter physics. Both laureates are long-standing perennial favourites, and both are of advanced age, which adds urgency for the committee.
